{{Quote|Hi! Welcome to Tatooine! Z-P70 at your service. But please call me Zeppo.|Zeppo|<ref name="JGG" />}}
'''Z-P70''', also known as '''Zeppo''', was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that helped [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] in his [[Wald's Parts|shop]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When an [[Unidentified extra-galactic spacer|extra-galactic spacer]] crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in need of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts from Watto's shop, Zeppo provided the spacer with information about [[Jabba's Game Plaza]] and the people who could help them earn [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="JGG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeppo first appeared in the [[2000]] children's game ''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''. His role was to give the player hints on the gameplay, and he was voiced by [[Doug Boyd]].<ref name="JGG" />
